name: feature.tool-output-compaction.nodes
description: Tool-output compaction node — an explicit mid-graph node that compacts a verbose JSON payload over the ctx.features['tool-output-compaction'] surface (one shared kernel). The default lossless mode DELETES INSIGNIFICANT WHITESPACE ONLY and changes no other byte; the optional lossy mode drops empty fields and elides long arrays, each disclosed in the payload (ADR 0604). Pure + deterministic ⇒ recorded output is replay-safe.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Compact Tool Output
nodes.description: Compacts a JSON string to cut token spend before it reaches a model. The default lossless mode deletes insignificant whitespace ONLY — no field is added or removed and no other byte changes. The optional lossy mode additionally drops structurally-empty fields (disclosed as _emptied) and elides long arrays (disclosed as _elided). Non-JSON passes through untouched. Over ctx.features['tool-output-compaction'].
